explanation: Genomics is the branch of molecular biology concerned with the structure, function, evolution, and mapping of genomes, which represent all the genetic information of an individual or species. The Human Genome Project (HGP) was a major effort that successfully mapped and sequenced the human genome. It took 13 years to sequence the three billion base pairs found along our chromosomes. The primary goals of the HGP were to determine the complete sequence of these base pairs and to construct a map showing the exact physical locations of genes on specific chromosomes.

questions.q: What were the primary goals of the Human Genome Project (HGP)?
opts: To clone human embryos and eliminate all germ-line mutations.
To determine the base pair sequence and construct a map showing gene locations on chromosomes.
To synthesize artificial restriction enzymes and DNA ligases.
To eliminate all introns from the human genome.
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide lists these two goals: 'Determine the base pair sequence' and 'Construct a map showing the sequences of genes on specific chromosomes.' The other options are incorrect.
